title: Getting started
summary: I can help you find a workspace and follow its documented steps. I cannot grant access, change records or read private worker data.
steps: Choose a task below or describe what you need.
Use the link in my answer to open the correct workspace.
Follow the normal approval and confirmation steps there.
prerequisites: Sign in with your own authorized identity. Local demo identities are fictional.

title: Onboard a new employee
summary: Create a worker with an approved role, site and valid employment dates.
steps: Open Employees and choose the new-worker action.
Enter a unique worker ID, name, email, role, site and dates.
Preview the proposed change, then apply it.
Verify qualifications and care assignments separately.
prerequisites: IAM operator required. An agency worker also needs a sponsor and current end date. Provisioning is local/mock.

title: Sponsor an agency worker or contractor
summary: Sponsors submit an intake; a different IAM operator approves it and creates a local worker record.
steps: Open Sponsor intake and enter the fictional worker details.
Select Agency or ThirdParty and a contract of up to 90 days.
Submit the intake and ask an independent operator to review it.
After approval, verify qualifications before care access.
prerequisites: Manager or IAM operator to submit; a different IAM operator to approve. No invitation email is sent.

title: Change a role or site
summary: Role and site changes must follow the controlled workforce workflow.
steps: Find the worker in Employees.
Open the move/role-change action.
Choose the new approved role and site, then preview/apply.
Verify previous access and session revocation, and request new app permissions if necessary.
prerequisites: IAM operator applies lifecycle moves. Managers can request/review changes through Access requests. Only current active workers may be moved.

title: Offboard or terminate a worker
summary: Termination disables the local identity and revokes sessions; connector reconciliation separately removes delivered app permissions.
steps: Find the worker and open their profile.
Use the leaver/termination action and review the confirmation.
Verify blocked status, removed role/assignments and revoked sessions.
Run reconciliation and process pending connector jobs; inspect the audit trail.
prerequisites: IAM operator required. You cannot terminate yourself or remove the last eligible operator. External applications are not connected.

title: Request and approve role access
summary: Access requests record a business reason and follow independent approval rules.
steps: Submit a request with role, site and business reason.
An eligible independent manager/operator reviews it.
Check request history for the decision and evidence.
Withdraw your own pending request if it is no longer needed.
prerequisites: Approval permissions depend on the requested role. Self-approval is denied; the assistant cannot approve for you.

title: Request application permissions
summary: Request a named app permission for a limited duration; approval and delivery are separate steps.
steps: Choose an eligible permission and duration.
Submit a business reason.
An independent reviewer approves; privileged requests require an IAM operator.
Ask the operator to process delivery jobs, then open the local resource check.
prerequisites: Ordinary permission lifetime: 5 to 10080 minutes. Privileged lifetime: 5 to 60 minutes. Real applications are not connected.

title: Schedule or cancel a care shift
summary: Care-record app access requires a current shift at the approved site, a current grant and valid qualifications.
steps: Managers/operators create a shift at the worker approved site.
Use UTC start/end times; maximum duration is 16 hours.
Avoid overlapping shifts and dates after the contract ends.
Cancel a shift when it is no longer needed; local resource checks deny access immediately.
prerequisites: Managers/operators edit shifts; workers see only their own. A shift alone does not grant access.

title: Reconcile application access
summary: Reconciliation compares current approved access with the local connector inventory and queues differences.
steps: Open Connector operations.
Run reconciliation to identify differences.
Process due delivery jobs.
Inspect results and attempt history.
prerequisites: IAM operator to run jobs. Auditor/manager views are read-only. This release uses a local connector, not live Entra or Microsoft 365.

title: Recover failed provisioning jobs
summary: A failed local delivery retries with a delay; after three failed attempts it enters the dead-letter list.
steps: Inspect the job and attempt history.
Resolve the connector problem; in the local demo, clear simulated failures.
For a dead job choose Retry.
Process due jobs and verify the delivered state.
prerequisites: IAM operator required. New execution rechecks current access so a stale job cannot regrant terminated access. Retry history is preserved.

title: Verify or renew qualifications
summary: Qualified care access requires current verified evidence. Expired qualifications block the relevant care access checks.
steps: Find the worker in Qualifications.
Choose Safeguarding or Professional registration.
Record the expiry date and an evidence reference.
Save and confirm that gaps/renewal alerts reflect the change.
prerequisites: Manager, IAM operator or delegated site administrator can verify within their scope. Nurses need safeguarding and professional registration.

title: Emergency break-glass access
summary: Emergency access is constrained to a resident and requires justification and independent review.
steps: Open Cover & emergencies.
A qualified nurse enters the resident, incident reference and emergency reason.
Use the short-lived grant only for its intended purpose.
A separate authorized reviewer reviews the event.
prerequisites: Use the actual policy limits displayed on the page. This does not grant administrator rights or bypass qualification requirements.

title: Temporary site cover
summary: Site cover follows manager and separate IAM-operator approval.
steps: Request a target site, duration and business reason.
Obtain the required two independent approval stages.
Check the resulting expiry and approved scope.
prerequisites: Current nurse eligibility and the configured cover policy apply. A roster shift is not an alternative to this approval.

title: Review workforce access
summary: Review whether access still matches each worker current duties.
steps: Open Access Reviews or Quarterly reviews.
Inspect the worker role, site and current needs.
Record retain/remove decision with a clear reason.
Follow up on remediation; do not review your own access.
prerequisites: Authorized independent reviewer required. A removal recommendation may require a separate lifecycle action.

title: Quarterly certification campaigns
summary: Campaigns organize access decisions for a defined review period.
steps: An IAM operator creates the quarterly campaign.
Independent reviewers inspect and decide assigned items.
Reconcile items if the worker state changed.
Track outstanding items and remediation.
prerequisites: Self-certification is denied. Reviewers must inspect current evidence.

title: Use notifications
summary: Filter reminders by text, category and read state. Marking a reminder read does not resolve the underlying issue.
steps: Open Notifications and apply filters.
Read one reminder or mark unread reminders on the displayed page.
Follow its link to resolve the underlying task.
prerequisites: Bulk read affects at most 25 current reminders and only your read state. Email delivery is not configured.

title: Save a personal filtered view
summary: Saved views reopen your filters using current data and permissions.
steps: Filter Employees, Notes or Review workbench.
Expand Save current view, name it and save.
Open Saved views to revisit or delete it.
prerequisites: Governance role required. Maximum 20 private views; names must be unique for your account.

title: Write and find handover notes
summary: Notes preserve contextual handover and governance evidence.
steps: Open Notes & handovers.
Search the complete history or filter by worker.
An authorized editor adds the category and note.
Review the saved note on the worker profile.
prerequisites: Managers/operators can add notes; auditors read. Use fictional data in the demonstration.

title: Investigate the audit trail
summary: Audit events record actors, targets, results and correlation identifiers.
steps: Open Audit Log and filter the events.
Inspect the action, result and correlation.
Use Security assurance to check ledger integrity.
Use the connector export links for bounded NDJSON or FHIR-shaped event exports.
prerequisites: Governance role required. Exports contain identifiers; handle them under your organisation privacy policy.

title: Reports and exports
summary: Reports summarize workforce and governance information in your permitted scope.
steps: Open Reports and apply filters.
Choose the available CSV or PDF export.
Check the scope and reporting period before sharing.
prerequisites: Reports are evidence snapshots, not a certification of regulatory compliance.

title: Run governance automation
summary: The daily governance job handles configured expiry and reminders. The application connector queue is a separate workflow.
steps: Open Control centre and review policies.
Run the daily job when due.
Inspect the result and any alerts.
For app permissions, also reconcile and process connector jobs.
prerequisites: IAM operator required. External scheduling is needed for unattended execution; use the documented queue CLI with one application process. App reconciliation/delivery can run in the same server process using SUNHAVEN_QUEUE_INTERVAL and SUNHAVEN_QUEUE_ACTOR.

title: Import a reviewed roster
summary: Roster CSV changes are staged for review before they can be applied.
steps: Paste CSV using the exact displayed column format.
Stage it and inspect the proposed changes.
A different approver approves the import.
An authorized operator distinct from the approver applies the fresh approved snapshot.
prerequisites: This is a reviewed manual import. No live HRIS connection or automatic external feed is configured.

title: Govern service and AI-agent identities
summary: Service and agent identities have a named owner, limited local scopes and an expiry.
steps: Open Service identities from Unified governance.
Register a bounded scope and owner.
Evaluate scope/expiry or disable an identity.
Use the workbench to replace an inactive owner.
prerequisites: IAM operator changes identities. This registers and evaluates local identities; it does not execute agents or rotate external secrets.

title: Explain access risk
examples: How do I check security risks?
summary: Risk explanations and recommendations help a human reviewer investigate. They do not automatically approve or remove high-risk access.
steps: Open Risk insights and inspect the explanation.
Check the linked evidence and current worker context.
Assign remediation or follow the appropriate approval workflow.
prerequisites: Existing insights are rule-based. Application-access insights separately show delivered permissions and observed usage.

title: Review policies and violations
summary: Policies describe access constraints and surface findings for investigation.
steps: Open Policies & risks.
Review the finding and affected scope.
Use an authorized workflow to resolve it and preserve evidence.
prerequisites: Policy findings require interpretation; a dashboard is not proof of legal compliance.

title: Sign-in, SSO and MFA
summary: The local demo uses fictional identities. Production-mode sign-in uses the existing Entra configuration and needs tenant validation.
steps: For a local demo choose a listed fictional identity.
For Entra, ask the administrator to configure tenant/app/redirect settings.
Configure and verify MFA/Conditional Access in the identity provider.
If sign-in expires, sign in again before submitting changes.
prerequisites: Never expose the password-free local demo to the public internet. The assistant cannot reset credentials or assert that MFA is configured.

title: Recover from an error
summary: Use the error message and request identifier to choose the recovery step.
steps: For expired sessions or CSRF, reload/sign in and review the form.
For conflict/409, reload current records before retrying.
For database busy/503, wait briefly and check whether the change committed.
For audit-integrity errors, preserve all evidence files and ask the operator to investigate.
prerequisites: Do not repeatedly submit a high-risk action without checking its current state. The assistant cannot inspect server logs.

title: Backup and restore
summary: Back up the database and its associated ledger files as one consistent set while writers are stopped.
steps: Stop writers and copy the entire data directory.
Preserve database, audit key, checkpoint and any journal/sidecars.
Restore to an isolated environment and verify integrity.
Rehearse with qa/backup_check.py before production operations.
prerequisites: Do not delete ledger files to bypass verification. Automated external backup storage is not connected.

title: Tablet navigation and keyboard shortcuts
summary: Use the collapsible menu on tablets, quick navigation and contextual help to move around.
steps: Open the menu; use Escape or the backdrop to close it.
Use Go to or Ctrl/Cmd+K to find a workspace.
Use Help on this page for contextual instructions.
Open Ask Sunhaven for guided task help.
prerequisites: Tables may scroll horizontally. The assistant does not execute the instructions for you.

title: Work through governance tasks
summary: The workbench brings pending approvals, certifications, remediation and emergency reviews together.
steps: Filter by task type, text or overdue state.
Open the task and inspect its evidence.
Use the authorized decision or reassignment action.
prerequisites: Actions retain their normal role and independence checks.

title: Request a local access package
summary: Access packages bundle a specific local workspace and limited duration.
steps: Choose an eligible package in Access catalogue.
Submit a business reason.
Wait for independent approval, then open the package resource.
prerequisites: Package expiry and separation-of-duty rules are enforced; a package is different from an application entitlement.

title: Find permitted residents
summary: The resident list is limited by your role, current assignments, site and qualification checks.
steps: Open Residents.
Select a resident you are authorized to see.
If a necessary resident is missing, ask the authorized manager/operator to review the assignment.
prerequisites: Do not use emergency access to avoid ordinary assignment controls.

title: Explore unified governance
summary: The governance hub links related operational modules.
steps: Open Unified governance.
Choose the relevant module: services, incidents, policy lab or integrations.
Use Help on this page for the module instructions.
prerequisites: Different modules have different authorization requirements.

title: Investigate compliance findings
summary: Compliance checks surface potential violations for human review.
steps: Open Compliance and review the findings.
Run checks if your role permits it.
Investigate current evidence and resolve through the appropriate controlled workflow.
prerequisites: Passing a check does not establish legal or regulatory compliance.

title: Manage a security incident
summary: Incident cases move through Open, Investigating, Contained and Resolved.
steps: Request the temporary incident-response package.
Obtain independent approval.
Create or transition a case with evidence and an accountable owner.
prerequisites: A valid incident-response package and eligible governance role are required.

title: Complete onboarding tasks
summary: The onboarding checklist records progress and supporting evidence.
steps: Open Onboarding and select the worker.
Review the required steps.
Record completion and evidence with the authorized editor.
prerequisites: A checklist does not replace verified qualifications, account approval or access provisioning.

title: Search the workspace
summary: Global search returns information within the scope of your identity.
steps: Enter at least two characters in the top search box.
Open a matching result.
For saved filters, use Employees, Notes or Review workbench.
prerequisites: Restricted worker/audit information is not exposed to ordinary workers.

title: AI workspace and access explanations
summary: Explain your current application access and review aggregate governance evidence.
steps: Open AI workspace.
Review your permission explanations.
Governance roles can inspect renewal counts, risk and review priorities.
Use the JSON briefing export for aggregate evidence.
prerequisites: Read-only explanations. Human approval is required for access changes; external model optional.

title: Manage workforce roles
examples: How do I manage employee roles?
summary: Open the workforce directory to inspect a worker and request or perform an authorized role change. Changes require the normal approval workflow.
steps: Find the worker in Employees.
Review current role, site and qualifications.
Use the authorized role change or access request workflow.
Inspect the decision, resulting worker state and audit trail.
prerequisites: An authorized manager or IAM operator and a documented business reason.

title: MFA analysis and team services
examples: Where is the Graph access review?
summary: Use Team services to run the integrated MFA detector and find the Entra access review lab.
steps: Open Team services.
Run the controlled MFA demonstration or submit normalized event CSV.
Review evidence and export the finding JSON.
Use the documented lab startup for live Entra review campaigns.
prerequisites: A governance role; live Entra operations separately require tenant setup.
